claims.statement: For every pair of genuine Boolean endpoints u,v and every genuine Boolean selector h on a disjoint block, with r=min(Pr[h=+1],Pr[h=-1]), delta=4r(1-r), and beta=Pr[u!=v], the selected function F satisfies H(F)<=(1-r)H(u)+rH(v)+beta H(h)+2 delta h2(beta)+8 beta h2(r).
claims.scope: All finite dimensions, all selector biases, all endpoint disagreement densities and correlation gaps; fresh disjoint selector/data blocks.

claims.statement: If H(u)<=C I(u), H(v)<=C I(v), and H(h)<=C I(h), then the same disjoint selected function satisfies H(F)<=(C+8)I(F).
claims.scope: One compositional node; constant 8 is sufficient and not claimed sharp.

claims.statement: The one-node parameter dependence is removed, but no one-use telescope is proved for the local disagreement/activation reserves over an arbitrary changing adaptive hierarchy, and shared-coordinate overlap remains unpaid.
